description: BUG-03: stamp writes a fingerprint only for a target it can honestly hash. An external URL, an outside-the-tree path, a directory and a binary file all keep their empty pin, and the tree is byte-identical to before stamp ran - previously every one of them was stamped with e3b0c442, the fingerprint of the empty string.

expect_json.detail: cannot fingerprint: no indexed text in blob.bin
